items.title: Be honest. At best you put enough real research to make 1–2 high conviction earnings bets a quarter. But you can’t stop yourself from playing all the big ones. Stop manufacturing conviction in your head. Cut the size of those side bets by 90%. You’ll get most of the same dopamine rush from being right when it happens with a tiny fraction of the financial risk.

items.title: I don’t have differentiated alpha on the memory bubble debate, but one important perspective: Sell side reports projecting the memory supply/demand imbalance to peak in the next few quarters are number crunchers modeling today’s known AI use cases. The problem is AI’s biggest use cases may not exist yet. I’d rather bet on AI creating unforeseen demand than on a spreadsheet correctly predicting its known memory needs two years from now. $SNDK $MU
